description: Public Wi-Fi Systems NYC is a dataset listed in City of New York open data portal (data.cityofnewyork.us), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of New York. The different providers in New York City of Public Wi-Fi at locations or “Hotspots” distributed across the city, not including service provided on buses or ferries. Coverage: New York City. The portal files it under the category City Government. Its tags are hotspot, public hotspots, public wi-fi, citywide computer centers, nyc wi-fi hotspot locations. The table has 8 columns. Attribution on the portal: Office of Technology and Innovation (OTI). The portal shows 2019-07-30 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofnewyork-us-portal.
